request.idea: Every clock in the world suddenly stops except one.

bible.title: The Clock That Kept Going
bible.narrativeComplexity: a question that can last across the book
bible.userIdea: Every clock in the world suddenly stops except one.
bible.premise: When every clock across the world stops except a small brass clock Ravi has lifted from a dusty shelf, three children investigate its hidden connection to the others.
bible.hook: Why does the brass clock still tick when all the others are silent?
bible.goal: Discover why the brass clock keeps ticking and restore the silent clocks.
bible.centralProblem: The children do not know that the clock Ravi removed supplies the ticks that all other clocks borrow.
bible.stakes: Until they uncover the connection, clocks everywhere remain motionless, and Ravi fears his cleaning has caused damage he cannot repair.
bible.motif: A single tick travelling along branching copper lines.
